def main():
    n = int(input())
    b = int(input())
    arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
    dp = [0] * n
    odd = 0
    even = 0
    l = 0
    j = 1
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if even == odd:
            dp[j] = abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i])
            j += 1
    dp = dp[:j]
    dp.sort()
    for i in range(1, j):
        dp[i] += dp[i - 1]
        if dp[i] <= b:
            l = i
    print(l)
